description: This Java source file defines the DocumentCentricActivity class, an Android activity demonstrating the use of the Document-Centric Apps API, especially handling document-related Intent flags and activity state management.

classes.name: DocumentCentricActivity
classes.description: An Android activity demonstrating document-centric behavior using intent flags like FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_DOCUMENT and handling activity state.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, and finds CheckBox view.

methods.name: onPostCreate
methods.description: Restores activity state from PersistableBundle if available.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves current document counter to PersistableBundle for state restoration.

methods.name: createNewDocument
methods.description: Handles button click to create a new document, conditionally adding flags for multiple task handling.

methods.name: newDocumentIntent
methods.description: Creates an Intent to start NewDocumentActivity as a new document, adding relevant flags and extras.

methods.name: incrementAndGet
methods.description: Increments and logs the document counter.
